name: OADC East London (ELS1)
developer: Open Access Data Centres (formerly NTT Data SA / Internet Solutions)
notes: OADC's official East London (ELS1) page lists a carrier-neutral, Tier-III-designed colocation data centre with 1MW site load, 68 sqm technical space, ISO 27001 and N+1 cooling redundancy. The site traces back to an Internet Solutions (Dimension Data) East London facility operated as NTT Data SA; OADC's acquisition of seven NTT Data centres across South Africa (incl. East London and Gqeberha) was finalised 31 Dec 2025, lifting OADC to 25MW.

name: ELIDZ Data Centre (Tier 3 expansion)
developer: East London Industrial Development Zone (ELIDZ) SOC Ltd
notes: ELIDZ official release (27 Mar 2024) states the zone runs a data centre facility and, seeing high demand for capacity, was completing a new state-of-the-art Tier 3 data centre to be expanded in phases, offering colocation, disaster recovery and cloud services. Backed by a blown fibre ring linking the facility to clients and external FNOs, ISO 27001/27017/27018 accreditations, and a 40MW grid supply within the zone. No public MW capacity figure for the data centre itself.

developer: Open Access Data Centres (formerly NTT Data SA / Internet Solutions)
notes: OADC's official Gqeberha (PLZ1) page lists a carrier-neutral Tier-III-designed colocation facility serving the Eastern Cape with 1MW site load, 95 sqm technical space, ISO 27001 and N+1 cooling. Situated at 271 Cape Rd, Newton Park, Gqeberha; PeeringDB records it as the NTT Data (MEA) Gqeberha site hosting the Nelson Mandela Bay Internet Exchange (NMBINX, 12 networks) with peers including WIOCC, Vumatel, DFA and Amobia. Formerly an Internet Solutions/NTT Data facility; acquired by OADC in the Dec 2025 seven-site NTT Data acquisition.
